data.standardized_narrative: The Syndicate reported a net prior year favourable development driven by a combination of favourable attritional claims experience and improvements on catastrophe claims across prior years. Using the gross claims development triangle, the Group's gross prior year release is approximately $32.6m (c. 5.4% of opening gross claims outstanding of $608.0m). The Managing Agent also discloses a net prior year favourable movement of $49.3m net of reinsurance. Named catastrophe events referenced include Hurricane Ian and Winter Storm Elliot (2022) which adversely affected the 2022 year, and more recent 2024 events such as Hurricane Helene, Hurricane Milton and the Oklahoma Tornadoes which were within expectations.

data.data_quality_notes: Gross prior year movement was not explicitly provided in the 'Movement in prior year's provision' note (that note reports net of reinsurance). A gross prior year movement was calculated from the gross claims development triangle (Note 15) and used as the primary prior_year_development_gbp_m (-32.58m). Per-line movements were taken from the Movement in prior year's provision table but that table is described in text as 'net of expected reinsurance recoveries' so those per-LOB figures are NET of reinsurance (flagged with lower confidence). All monetary amounts are presented in the report's native currency (USD) and in millions.
